records.title: FacilityOps Milestone 3 fictional profile and qualitative design-intent directive
records.potential_applicability_trigger: Use of the fictional flagship profile and qualitative synthetic sequence-of-operation intent in FacilityOps.
records.direct_support: Records the project-owner decisions that define the fictional profile and the ten accepted qualitative synthetic requirements.
records.uncertainty: The directive creates project intent only; it does not create legal applicability, physical authorization, or a standards requirement.

records.title: Flagship simulation applicability profile
records.potential_applicability_trigger: Deterministic fictional scenario design within the exact package version.
records.direct_support: Provides explicit simulation bounds and exclusions without asserting that the bounds satisfy any legal or technical threshold.
records.uncertainty: The simulation assumptions require domain review before they may be described as representative practice.

records.issuer: New York State Fire Prevention and Building Code Council and New York State Department of State
records.title: Notice of Adoption — Rules Amending and Updating the Uniform Code
records.potential_applicability_trigger: Regulated construction, occupancy, equipment, or fire-safety work in New York outside New York City.
records.direct_support: Identifies the adopted 2025 New York Uniform Code books, effective date, adoption path, and the current limited enforcement exception recorded by the State.
records.uncertainty: Permit date, exact site facts, local amendments, variances, and section-level applicability remain unverified; the recorded fossil-fuel exception does not materially affect this proof.

records.title: New York Executive Law Article 18 — Uniform Fire Prevention and Building Code Act
records.potential_applicability_trigger: Identification of the local government responsible for Uniform Code administration and enforcement.
records.direct_support: Supports treating a town as the relevant local-government reference outside incorporated villages and identifies local code-administration responsibilities subject to statutory alternatives.
records.uncertainty: The fictional facility has no parcel; opt-out status, county involvement, intermunicipal agreements, and actual responsibility require direct verification. Section 381 is separately available at https://www.nysenate.gov/legislation/laws/EXC/381.

records.issuer: New York State Department of State
records.title: Uniform Code and the Energy Code: Minimum Standards for Administration and Enforcement
records.edition_or_effective_date: Replacement rule effective 2022-12-30; courtesy copy current to 2026-02-20
records.potential_applicability_trigger: A local government administering the Uniform and Energy Codes.
records.direct_support: Describes minimum local code-enforcement program functions and records.
records.uncertainty: The Department of State identifies the online material as a courtesy copy; a legal determination requires the official compilation and current local program records.

records.issuer: Town Board of the Town of Horseheads
records.title: Code of the Town of Horseheads, Chapter 83 — Building Code Administration
records.identifier: Local Law 1-2006 as amended by Local Law 1-2024
records.potential_applicability_trigger: Regulated buildings, premises, work, and activities within Town enforcement territory.
records.direct_support: Creates the Town Code Enforcement Officer role and assigns local administration and enforcement functions for the Uniform Code, Energy Code, permits, inspections, certificates, records, and enforcement.
records.uncertainty: The codification contains some references to older State code books; later local laws, filings, agreements, parcel location, and current permit policy require verification.

records.title: Code Enforcement and Building Permits
records.potential_applicability_trigger: Local permit or enforcement contact for a property in Town territory.
records.direct_support: The Town publicly identifies its Code Enforcement office and its New York State code-enforcement role.
records.uncertainty: An administrative webpage does not determine jurisdiction for a real parcel or resolve agreements, amendments, or permit scope.

records.issuer: New York State Department of State and State Fire Prevention and Building Code Council
records.title: 2025 Building Code of New York State
records.potential_applicability_trigger: Classification and design of a new research laboratory in New York outside New York City.
records.direct_support: Provides the adopted occupancy, construction, use, and hazardous-material classification framework; testing and research laboratories can fall within the Group B framework under applicable facts.
records.uncertainty: Group B is not established by the laboratory label alone; complete use, material, quantity, control-area, fire-area, and building facts require qualified review. Full code text is copyrighted.

records.issuer: New York State Department of State and State Fire Prevention and Building Code Council
records.title: 2025 Mechanical Code of New York State
records.identifier: 2025 MCNYS; Chapter 5 and Section 509 research pointers
records.potential_applicability_trigger: A code-required contaminant exhaust system or an operation meeting the hazardous-exhaust triggers.
records.direct_support: Provides the adopted framework for contaminant exhaust, makeup air, and hazardous exhaust; specified laboratory-manifold conditions can involve redundant fans.
records.uncertainty: The current profile does not establish a hazardous-exhaust trigger or use of the relevant manifold provision. It is not a direct basis for the duty/standby pair, treatment dependency, pressure criterion, or FacilityOps sequence. Full code text is copyrighted.

records.issuer: New York State Department of State and State Fire Prevention and Building Code Council
records.title: 2025 Fire Code of New York State
records.potential_applicability_trigger: A material classification, quantity, storage or use condition, process, or permit threshold.
records.direct_support: Provides the adopted hazardous-material classification and permit framework in which material category, quantity, storage, use, and control-area facts matter.
records.uncertainty: Simulation inventory bounds do not prove a threshold conclusion; exact composition, SDS, hazard category, aggregate quantity, control areas, and AHJ interpretation are missing. Full code text is copyrighted.

records.issuer: United States Department of Labor, Occupational Safety and Health Administration
records.title: New York State Plan
records.identifier: OSHA State Plan profile for New York
records.potential_applicability_trigger: Private-sector employer and covered employee work in New York.
records.direct_support: Identifies Federal OSHA as the reference regulator for private-sector employment in New York and New York PESH for state and local government employment.
records.uncertainty: The fictional profile does not identify an actual employer, workforce, employment relationship, or covered work activity.

records.issuer: United States Department of Labor, Occupational Safety and Health Administration
records.title: Occupational exposure to hazardous chemicals in laboratories
records.potential_applicability_trigger: Covered laboratory use of a hazardous chemical with potential employee exposure.
records.direct_support: Where applicable, establishes Chemical Hygiene Plan, control-measure, information, training, record, and protective-equipment performance obligations.
records.uncertainty: Hazard classification, employee exposure potential, laboratory-use facts, and protective practices are incomplete. It supplies no direct basis for the synthetic permissive, fan selection, changeover, pressure cascade, treatment dependency, or recovery logic.

records.issuer: United States Department of Labor, Occupational Safety and Health Administration
records.title: Limits for Air Contaminants, Table Z-1
records.potential_applicability_trigger: Covered employee exposure to alpha-alumina or another listed particulate.
records.direct_support: Identifies alpha-alumina by substance and CAS identity as a regulated air contaminant with exposure limits.
records.uncertainty: The fictional alumina-based powder lacks a supplier SDS, CAS identities, composition, particle-size distribution, crystalline-silica assessment, and exposure data. Regulatory exposure limits must not be repurposed as FacilityOps airflow or permissive criteria.

records.issuer: United States Department of Labor, Occupational Safety and Health Administration
records.title: Hazard Communication
records.edition_or_effective_date: Revised standard effective 2024-07-19 with transition provisions; current text accessed 2026-07-22
records.potential_applicability_trigger: A known workplace chemical for which covered employees may be exposed.
records.direct_support: Establishes the importance of product identity, hazard classification, labels, safety data sheets, and employee information; the supplier SDS is a required future controlled artifact for this profile.
records.uncertainty: Exact product classification is absent, and the profile does not establish a regulatory exception or final hazard determination.

records.title: Laboratory Ventilation
records.potential_applicability_trigger: Project selection of laboratory-ventilation practice for a research laboratory controlling airborne particulate exposure.
records.direct_support: Provides a potentially relevant laboratory-ventilation practice framework, including management, supply and exhaust relationships, exposure-control devices, performance testing, maintenance, and responsibilities.
records.uncertainty: No adoption, incorporation, contractual selection, or enforcement is established. Full text is paid; exact requirements and numerical values require licensed review and domain approval.

records.title: Fundamentals Governing the Design and Operation of Local Exhaust Ventilation Systems
records.potential_applicability_trigger: Project selection for a fixed local exhaust system intended to control airborne particulate exposure.
records.direct_support: Provides potentially relevant local-exhaust design, air-cleaner, air-mover, discharge, replacement-air, commissioning, operation, maintenance, and testing concepts.
records.uncertainty: No adoption or project selection is established; full text is paid and overlap with the laboratory-specific source requires qualified review.

records.title: Standard for Exhaust Systems for Air Conveying of Vapors, Gases, Mists, and Particulate Solids
records.potential_applicability_trigger: An exhaust system within the standard's fire or explosion protection scope conveying particulate solids.
records.direct_support: Provides potentially relevant fire and explosion protection concepts for qualifying particulate-conveying exhaust systems.
records.uncertainty: The profile declares noncombustible material and excludes combustible dust. Full-text and process-specific review are needed; this source does not establish inhalation control, treatment, or the synthetic sequence.

records.title: National Electrical Code
records.identifier: NFPA 70; New York adopted-edition verification tracked separately
records.edition_or_effective_date: 2026 publisher-current; New York 2025 rule materials identify the incorporated edition separately
records.potential_applicability_trigger: Electrical installation of VFDs, motors, wiring, controllers, and instrumentation.
records.direct_support: Provides the model electrical-installation basis when the adopted edition and exact installation scope are established.
records.uncertainty: Publisher-current and jurisdiction-adopted editions differ. Installation conformance cannot prove VFD state, motor response, delivered airflow, or evidentiary independence.

records.issuer: Air Movement and Control Association International and ASHRAE
records.title: Laboratory Methods of Testing Fans for Certified Aerodynamic Performance Rating
records.potential_applicability_trigger: Selection or verification of certified fan aerodynamic ratings.
records.direct_support: Provides uniform laboratory fan-rating concepts for airflow, pressure, power, speed, density, and efficiency.
records.uncertainty: No project selection is established, and a laboratory rating is not evidence of installed fan operation or delivered system airflow.

records.issuer: Air Movement and Control Association International
records.title: Fans and Systems
records.edition_or_effective_date: 2023 publication; under review on access date
records.potential_applicability_trigger: Assessment of installed fan performance in a shared duct, treatment, and system configuration.
records.direct_support: Provides system-effect concepts explaining why installed performance can differ from laboratory fan ratings.
records.uncertainty: Paid text and project-specific system data are required; it supplies no acceptance criterion. Its relevant influence is that fan or VFD indications do not prove delivered airflow.

records.title: Standard Methods for Air Velocity and Airflow Measurement; Standard Methods for Pressure Measurement; Standard Methods for Power Measurement
records.edition_or_effective_date: Published editions identified in the source title
records.potential_applicability_trigger: Future airflow, differential-pressure, or motor-power evidence measured under a controlled method.
records.direct_support: Provides prospective measurement-method and metadata references for airflow, pressure, and power evidence.
records.uncertainty: The standards are unselected and provide methods rather than the flagship criteria, sensor locations, tolerances, staleness rules, or evidence-sufficiency decisions.

records.title: Measurement, Testing, Adjusting, and Balancing of Building Heating, Ventilation and Air-Conditioning Systems
records.potential_applicability_trigger: Future field airflow, pressurization, control-subsystem, and performance evidence.
records.direct_support: Provides prospective field measurement, testing, balancing, instrumentation, data-validation, recording, and reporting concepts.
records.uncertainty: No project selection is established. Future evidence needs instrument identity, calibration, setup, uncertainty, operating mode, and test authority; a TAB record is not FacilityOps authorization or commissioning acceptance.

records.title: The Commissioning Process Requirements for New Buildings and New Systems
records.potential_applicability_trigger: Project selection of a commissioning process for a new building or new system.
records.direct_support: Provides informative process architecture separating project requirements, verification, documentation, issues, reports, and human acceptance.
records.uncertainty: No legal adoption or contractual selection is established. FacilityOps replay is not a commissioning project, and computed output cannot substitute for qualified commissioning or owner acceptance.

records.title: High Performance Sequences of Operation for HVAC Systems
records.potential_applicability_trigger: Use as a representation specimen for structured sequence intent and testing concepts.
records.direct_support: Provides informative examples of explicit modes, inputs, outputs, state transitions, fault conditions, and functional tests.
records.uncertainty: It is not the source for the flagship process-exhaust sequence and must not be traced as a code or owner requirement.

records.title: A Control Description Language for Building Environmental Control Sequences
records.potential_applicability_trigger: Optional future comparison of one bounded control sequence representation.
records.direct_support: Provides informative declarative, human-readable and machine-readable control-sequence concepts with explicit connectors, parameters, blocks, documentation, simulation, and CXF exchange.
records.uncertainty: FacilityOps does not implement a CDL engine. Modeled controller logic cannot prove I/O correctness, equipment response, airflow, pressure, or facility consequence.

records.issuer: United States Department of Energy and Lawrence Berkeley National Laboratory
records.title: OpenBuildingControl verification specification
records.identifier: OpenBuildingControl research specification and working report
records.potential_applicability_trigger: Use of reproducible controller-output comparison concepts for a later bounded research comparison.
records.direct_support: Provides informative archived replay, pinned parameter, mapping, unit-conversion, time-tolerance, value-tolerance, and reproducible comparison concepts while explicitly separating verification from physical validation.
records.uncertainty: It is evolving research, not an adopted standard. It places I/O correctness, sensor installation, mechanical performance, and envelope performance outside sequence-logic verification.

records.title: Method of Test for Control Programming Conformance with HVAC Sequences of Operation
records.edition_or_effective_date: Proposed project authorized 2025-10-27; no published edition
records.potential_applicability_trigger: Future comparison with bounded controller-program test scripts after publication and exact review.
records.direct_support: Its public scope provides informative concepts for defined test conditions, expected controller responses, and bounded controller-program testing through BACnet without physical sensors or devices.
records.uncertainty: No standard has been published. Final content and scripts are unknown; it cannot support a current compliance, conformance, or dependency claim.
